exposure: Future controlled evaluation of rain and splash, humidity, condensation, dust and wet-ground proximity; puddle entry, immersion and flood operation are excluded
project_notes: Separate indoor HOME and outdoor NOMAD environmental envelopes. Quadruped joints, actuators, cable entries, battery compartment and service panels require configuration-specific protection and validation. Sensor names are proposed monitoring requirements, not evidence of installed hardware. No water entry, immersion, flood/current operation or automatic wet-recovery behavior is implied.
